description_ru: Nearshore sediment veneer: sand and gravel ridges on wave-washed glaciofluvial deposits (glacial Lake Agassiz)
Offshore glaciolacustrine sediments: clay, silt, sand, veneer to 20 m; iceberg scours, extensive peat
Outwash: rounded cross-stratified sand and gravel, 3-20 m
Ice-contact stratified drift: kames, eskers, moraines
Till veneer: sandy, <1 m, with bedrock, marine or lacustrine patches
Precambrian rock: massive granitic and gneissic rock
